result.rationale: In zoho-bigin/lib/CalendarService.ts, tokenInfo = await refreshOAuthTokens(...). refreshOAuthTokens (new file) returns a raw fetch Response when APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT, while the caller expects an axios response with .data. The unchanged line `if (!tokenInfo.data.error)` then throws TypeError since fetch Response has no data property. The diff shows the same issue for zohocrm too. Mechanism is verifiable from the diff.

judged_text: With credential sharing enabled tokenInfo is a raw fetch Response, so tokenInfo.data is undefined and the unchanged `if (!tokenInfo.data.error)` line throws TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'error'). Every zoho-bigin token refresh under sharing mode crashes the calendar operation with an unhandled TypeError instead of applying the synced token.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/zoho-bigin/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the refresh path was changed to `const tokenInfo = await refreshOAuthTokens(...)` and the subsequent logic still assumes an Axios response: `if (!tokenInfo.data.error) { ... }`. However, `refreshOAuthTokens` (new in `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`) returns a raw `fetch(...)` `Response` object when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId` is truthy. A `Response` has no `.data`, so `tokenInfo.data` is `undefined` and `tokenInfo.data.error` will throw a TypeError under sharing mode.
